claims.statement: Tistory formally retired its documented Open API by the end of February 2024.
claims.uncertainty: A later official replacement must be independently verified before use.
claims.temporal_qualifier: Applies to the documented Open API retirement notice.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before selecting any external write mechanism.

claims.statement: The safe initial delivery path is an offline editor-ready package unless a current official write mechanism is verified.
claims.uncertainty: The editor surface is supported, but no official browser-write automation authorization was found.
claims.temporal_qualifier: An offline package is the initial route; it is not evidence that browser automation is allowed.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before any live publishing integration or policy change.

claims.statement: Google permits AI assistance only when content remains people-first and is not scaled mainly to manipulate ranking.
claims.uncertainty: Official guidance does not offer a deterministic ranking formula or a blanket AI permission.
claims.temporal_qualifier: Evaluate purpose, value, accuracy, and review rather than the generation method alone.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before changing generation workflow or prompt policy.

claims.statement: Naver guidance requires useful originality and experience-enriched content and rejects copied, stuffed, clickbait, or unreviewed AI-summary patterns.
claims.uncertainty: Naver publishes no complete ranking formula or blanket AI ban.
claims.temporal_qualifier: Search Advisor is the policy owner for this guidance.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before changing originality or search-quality gates.

claims.statement: AdSense policy requires genuine user interest and prohibits artificial interactions and deceptive click inducement.
claims.uncertainty: There is no numeric safe traffic threshold or blanket AI rule.
claims.temporal_qualifier: Publisher and invalid-traffic policies must both be satisfied.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before enabling ads, affiliate measurement, or traffic acquisition.

claims.statement: Compensated Korean blog recommendations require conspicuous economic-interest disclosure.
claims.uncertainty: Application to an individual post can be fact-specific and is not decided automatically.
claims.temporal_qualifier: Use a conspicuous title or opening disclosure when the economic-interest facts require it.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before publishing sponsored, affiliate, or compensated recommendations.

claims.statement: Private Search Console and Analytics data require owner-authorized property access and documented scope.
claims.uncertainty: Offline fixtures cannot establish access to private properties.
claims.temporal_qualifier: Unauthorized or unavailable metrics remain unknown, never zero.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before connecting Search Console, GA4, or another private analytics service.

claims.statement: The initial workspace contained no blog URL, content inventory, analytics, or prior project assets.
claims.uncertainty: This only describes the inspected workspace, not the owner's external accounts or blog.
claims.temporal_qualifier: Re-run after the owner supplies a URL, export, or authorized data source.
claims.recheck_trigger: When new project assets or owner-authorized data become available.

claims.statement: Privacy and analytics controls must remain owner-controlled and specific to the actual controller and data flow.
claims.uncertainty: There is no universal consent configuration independent of controller, purpose, vendor, and transfer facts.
claims.temporal_qualifier: The system records and gates facts; it does not make an individualized legal determination.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before enabling cookies, ads, telemetry, or cross-border data transfers.

claims.statement: Tistory prohibits anchor and offerwall advertisement formats.
claims.uncertainty: No newer superseding notice was found in the completed research; current policy must be rechecked before live ads.
claims.temporal_qualifier: The platform-specific allowlist is stricter than provider defaults where they differ.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before enabling, changing, or testing an advertisement format.

claims.statement: Naver Search Advisor exposure and click reports are partial, delayed, top-30-limited, and retained for at most 90 days.
claims.uncertainty: The report is not total or real-time Naver traffic and authenticated export availability remains unknown.
claims.temporal_qualifier: Store source, surface, period, collection time, and truncation context with every metric.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before designing a Naver metrics connector or making attribution claims.

claims.statement: KFTC Directive No. 499 adds conditional disclosure for AI-generated virtual-person endorsements.
claims.uncertainty: Ordinary non-endorsement AI illustrations are outside this specific condition, but other disclosure duties may still apply.
claims.temporal_qualifier: Apply the rule only when the content presents an AI virtual person as an endorsement or recommendation.
claims.recheck_trigger: Before using an AI virtual person in promotional or recommendation content.

claims.statement: Daum service operation transferred to AXZ on 2025-12-01, but the exact current Tistory controller remains unsettled.
claims.uncertainty: The first-party transfer notice does not name Tistory or prove a later controller relationship.
claims.temporal_qualifier: controller must be re-verified before any live integration
claims.recheck_trigger: Before collecting personal data, connecting private analytics, or enabling a live adapter.
